adjudications.item: TT-021 (44 entries differ from the worktree)
adjudications.what_the_owner_shipped_before_this_study: TT-021 existed only as a measurement ('41/1085 stale')
adjudications.what_the_owner_should_rule: treat the 44 as BENIGN epoch drift explained by the seal, and make that fact decidable by the tool rather than by a hand audit
adjudications.evidence: five-basis classification: UNEXPLAINED = 0; no tracked evidence byte needs to change
rejected_alternatives: re-seal at HEAD (churn + tracked-artifact + crosswalk digest changes, four consumers reconcile against those bytes)
prune the diverging entries (destroys the snapshot)
adjudications.residual_risk_disclosed: the CRLF/worktree reading is the best-fitting explanation of all 44 residuals, not a proven fact: no archived worktree copy exists

adjudications.decision: ADOPT F-020-A-BASIS; the verifier delivered this round becomes the consumer-facing check
adjudications.what_the_owner_should_rule: wire the verifier into the round's evidence build as a REPORTING step; stale is not failure, UNEXPLAINED_DRIFT is
adjudications.evidence: no existing consumer recomputes a per-entry digest or reads a classification field, so adding one breaks nothing (challenger F8, re-checked against build_publication_manifest.py, build_evidence_md.py and the three tests)
adjudications.correction_delivered: the verifier's docstring says '41 of 1085 entries are stale'; the measured value is 44 -- prose drift to correct in the same change

adjudications.item: TT-024 (recorded candidate_head that is not an ancestor of HEAD)
adjudications.what_the_owner_should_rule: the 21 are a KNOWN CLASS (cross-line generation identity from the r2/r3 lines, all dated 2026-10-09), not a defect; keep the one enforced assertion (T4) as it is because it holds
adjudications.evidence: ancestry is already report-only in verify_evidence_digests.py; the only enforcement, tests/test_s4ext_artifact_reproducibility.py T4, passes on s1/TECHNOLOGY_ADMISSIONS.json
adjudications.if_a_hard_signal_is_wanted_later: the strictly stronger report-only check is 'the recorded revision resolves AND its tree contains the path with the recorded bytes' (generation reproducibility), not 'resolves' alone
rejected_alternatives: fatal ancestry for all 56 (rejects 21 legitimate identities and any rebase/squash/shallow clone)

adjudications.item: TT-023 (the EXECUTE lane's declared model cannot sustain tool calls)
adjudications.decision: ADOPT F-023-A-PROBE-AND-RECORD; REJECT the in-repo adapter patch and the SoD change
adjudications.what_the_owner_should_rule: the lane must PROBE eligibility with a live two-turn tool call before a long run, pin the probed model, and record declared versus actual in the receipt; escalate the adapter defect (it must echo reasoning_content) to the adapter/provider owner
adjudications.evidence: the catalogue exposes no usable flag for any deepseek entry, so eligibility is only decidable empirically; a same-provider sibling completes the probe
rejected_alternatives: change the EXECUTE model family (alters the declared separation of duties; unnecessary)
patch the adapter in this repo (unowned fork of an external contract)
adjudications.residual_risk_disclosed: the escalation has no in-repo evidence path until the adapter owner answers; the lane must keep substituting-and-declaring meanwhile
